sources: ランディングページ（LP）集めました。

yield_judgment: Mechanism yield declined 14% → 10% → 6% while source diversity and same-industry density increased. Later samples mostly reinforced/refined existing family/module grammar rather than producing new families.
saturated_or_pause_worthy: photography-led lifestyle hero as a standalone mechanism
remaining_limits: The full 300 corpus cannot be given an exact six-source distribution because the first 150 historical source counts were not safely recoverable.
Motion remains less deeply verified than static composition; recordings are not counted as meaningful motion without semantic evidence.
The 24-pair resemblance set is a calibration basis, not enough for a numeric hard threshold.
Beauty/Wellness family taxonomy is research-validated but not Production-locked until multi-company selector validation.
Discovery stopped at 300, not 500, because all Sarah closure requirements were met at the lower bound and later-batch mechanism yield fell to 6%.
stop_rationale: Stop new broad discovery at 300 for this Issue #44 research cycle: multi-source participation is direct and auditable, Beauty/Wellness evidence is materially denser, Deep reaches 60, Strong reaches 100, pair calibration exists, mobile evidence expanded, and late-batch mechanism yield is declining. Additional volume is more likely to improve calibration precision than change the architecture taxonomy.
next_gate: Sarah PM audit. No Nagi or Production implementation before acceptance.
